reviews.title: Bad performance
reviews.review_text: It worked pretty well at first but ever since I upgraded my watch it did not charge it as fast anymore. Takes forever to charge my phone I stopped using it for the phone. Terrible at charging more than one device at a time

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.review_text: First of all this product looks very nice. Solid construction and feels good to the touch however the watch charger barely functions for the series 7 apple watch. I purchased specifically for the fast charge functionality and with os 8.5.1 it hardly charges at all. My much cheaper no name 3rd party charge stand is faster. Hopefully there is an update soon and things go back to as intended but for now the watch station is useless

reviews.title: Slow charge
reviews.review_text: I am very disappointed in this device and how long it takes to charge my phone. Not worth the $ and wish I could return for something different.

reviews.title: Apple Watch S7 fast charging doesn't work!
reviews.review_text: Apple Watch S7 fast charging doesn't work! There is a lot of buyers that are posting the same issue and BELKIN don't have a solution! The best feature of the product doesn't works! So disappointed with this product. :(

reviews.title: Do waste your money
reviews.review_text: Delivered 5 days late even after paying premium for express delivery. Slow charger NOT the fast charger as advertised. Returned ~ postage not paid by Belkin.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I was really excited to get this and have less clutter on my nightstand. It works ok, but I wouldn't recommend or purchase again. Pros: Very sleek and looks great, charges my AirPods and Apple Watch quickly Cons: The iPhone charger is not efficient! I have left my iPhone on the charger for 2 hours to only get 5% charge. It's been very disappointing and I no longer even use it for my phone which was a big factor in my purchase.

reviews.title: Watch charger doesn't work.
reviews.review_text: Watch charger doesn't work. Charges very very slowly. It's not usable at all.

reviews.title: Product sucks.
reviews.review_text: Phone often not charged in the morning. It apparently has to be laying perfectly on the spot to get a full charge. Not a fan

reviews.title: Not for android watches.
reviews.review_text: This does not work with the samsung watches. it did charge my phone but would push my watch away. It does charge the apple watches as that is what my wife has.

reviews.title: Needs some improvement
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Sleek design. Slow to charge. I have to manipulate the phone to get the charger to start working. I think it's because it's just a regular phone case.

reviews.title: Good, but a bit not the easiest to place phone
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Sleek and compact, but flat surface gets a bit difficult to use with phone. Somewhat Apple's fault, but still miss and have to readjust for optimal position of phone for magnetic lock.

reviews.title: Apple Watch 7 Charges Super Slow
reviews.review_text: Fast charging the apple watch is a known issue on the latest version of the watchOS (8.5). It is a shame that this is advertised to fast charge but the functionality broke after a software update. This may not have been the fault of Belkin engineers and they did a great job designing this charger. Still disappointed with my experience and eagerly waiting for a fix. Otherwise, it has a nice, premium design with presumable support for current and future devices.

reviews.title: Watch settings/ lack of written instructikns
reviews.review_text: Just opened the box - it was a gift from Apple. The lack of a manual / instructions is very annoying. There are apparently different settings for different Apple I watches. With a bunch of diagrams that tell you that there are three different watch settings without any clue as to how you move the settings and which settings you should move it to.

reviews.title: Problem Charging Apple Watch Series 7
reviews.review_text: I am having same issue as other reviewers have noted charging my Apple Watch Series 7. Unit started charging like a champ when purchased at the start of the year. Now takes hours to charge watch. May be related to recent iOS upgrades??? NEEDS A FIX!!!

reviews.title: Does NOT fast-charge Apple Watch 7, takes HOURS!
reviews.review_text: The only reason to buy this expensive product instead of one of its competitors would be for the fast-charging feature that Belkin advertises that it provides for Apple Watch 7. But that feature has not worked with the current version of WatchOS since mid-March 2022. Belkin tech support is useless, saying only that Belkin is 'investigating' the problem, but not providing any estimate of when they'll provide a fix.

reviews.title: Apple Watch Charger
reviews.review_text: Ever since Apple Watch OS updated to 8.5 tony Watch has not charged on this device. Belkin, you've acknowledged this but I can't track any progress on the issue and don't know if any fix is even possible since it's just a charger and I can't see apple reversing whatever change they made. Please provide some more info/clarity on this issue!

reviews.title: Great Idea, but watch doesn't charge
reviews.review_text: The product is a great space-saving device. Unfortunately at some point along the way (Belkin support is blaming a watch os upgrade), the watch no longer charges. Or charges VERY slowly when it will. Kind of disappointing to have the device fail in one of three slots already. I opted for this largely because of fast charging support for watch series 7, so to have this busted defeats the entire purpose.

reviews.title: Input power with DC barrel - REALLY?
reviews.review_text: Why, why, and why again. 2022 and you develop a excellent product without a USB-C input? I tested the product at a friend's house, amazing, I already had the product in my cart to buy and decided to go read the specs... INPUT: Barrel DC This was my worst turn off I've ever had.

reviews.title: Would not charge Apple Watch or Airpods
reviews.review_text: I was having problems getting my Apple Watch Series 7 to charge using this device. I worked through Belkins technical support and the concluded the device was defective. Through testing we also identified that the AirPods were not charging. I'm in the process of returning the product. I am fairly disappointed as I really like the look and idea of a product that can do fast charging with my iPhone and Apple Watch. While other Belkin options look great, I'm cautious to buy another Belkin product as I've lost confidence in their product quality control and quality assurance.

reviews.title: Worst performance
reviews.review_text: Very slow charging yuyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy
Very high quality made. It's a pity that the power supply will be difficult to replace if necessary, and it is quite large in size.

reviews.title: Inconsistent performance
reviews.review_text: This would be a great product if it performed as advertised. However, the watch will sometimes charge rapidly but other times very slowly. It's very frustrating.

reviews.title: expensive and now I have a slow brick
reviews.review_text: after 3 days of use the equipment stopped working properly. I thought I could charge my apple products quickly and safely and it turns out that my watch series 7 takes almost 12 hours!!! really, as other users say, do not buy it

reviews.title: Better off buying in store!
reviews.review_text: Spending a week chasing the missing A/C adapter that was supposed to be included in the box Required a second credit card purchase - just to have a replacement mailed - pretty shady if you ask me.

reviews.title: belkin please fix fast charge
reviews.review_text: I bought the device for one reason and that was because it could fast charge my new series 7 watch at the store they recommended the belkin 3-1 and unfortunately my watch takes 8 hours to charge. Belkin please solve the problem!!!

reviews.title: Hard to find proper placement for phone
reviews.review_text: Kinda unhappy with the fact that I have to find the precise location for my phone to actually charge on this thing. Don't know if it's because of the otter box case I have or not, other than that it's great.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.review_text: I wouldn't recommend it. It doesn't charge the phone right

reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.review_text: I don't like the barrel charger & no matter where I plug it in something doesn't charge. I either get a dead battery on my phone, sometimes my watch and today it's my headphone case - charged all night and it's running on empty. Lights and devices indicate they are charging but obviously not so well. Belkin if you read this, please reach out.

reviews.title: Both chargers stopped working
reviews.review_text: Great design, Belkin must be having quality issues. Received 2 chargers on January 3rd, 2022. Both stopped charging iPhones last week. What a paint to return charges for replacements. Still have no idea if Belkin fixed the issue or if replacement is on it's way.

reviews.title: Watch Series 7
reviews.review_text: After updating my watch series 7 to 8.5 the fast wireless charging not working and it just charges 5% within an hour.

reviews.title: Apple watch 7 won't fast charge
reviews.review_text: Bought this to have an additional fast charger for apple watch 7 series but it doesn't work...have to go back to the apple charging puck.

reviews.title: Doesn't work with AppleWatch 7
reviews.review_text: I bought this product because it states “fast charge of AppleWatch 7” - but this is NOT happening - charging takes hours. It's also veeeery slow at charging an iPhone XS. Waste of money as it is now.

reviews.title: Terrible design. Terrible quality.
reviews.review_text: Really awful. Terrible cord. Visible and cheap looking. Phone stops charging for no reason...can't get the air pods to charge. Watch is fine but what a waste.

reviews.title: Slow watch charging
reviews.review_text: I bought this specifically for the fast charging on my new Apple Watch. It takes hours to charge. The charger that came with the watch is very fast. Disappointed.

reviews.title: Why doesn't the unit charge AirPods? Why?
reviews.review_text: The unit initially seemed to be a great idea. My iPhone 15 charges as well as my watch. The AirPods…not so much. Then I read other users having the same problem!. They don't charge at all. For the price, one would expect a fully functional unit.

reviews.title: Horrible phone charger
reviews.review_text: Trying to get my daughter's iPhone 13 mini to wireless charge on this is so hard. 60% of the time it doesn't fully charge. To have this tjis cost 150 and to perform the way that it does is unacceptable. My wife has a different brand wireless charger that was way cheaper and it charges 100% of the time. This thing has a really weak charge connection with the phones.

reviews.title: Great, but unplug when not charging
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The issue I've noticed it's that it's an energy hog when plugged in but not charging. I was using a power station attached to a solar panel while camping. I left it plugged in overnight by mistake with no devices attached and it completely drained the power station from a 45% charge. Be sure to unplug when not in use. It seems to be quite a vampire. In reality, remember to unplug all devices when not in use unless it's horribly inconvenient.

reviews.title: Replacement Stopped Working YOU HAVE A PROBLEM
reviews.review_text: Belkin, You have a serious issue, my replacement stopped charging my phone. The design is great if it would just work. After resetting my phone looks like it started working. My assumption is the power management on the phone overheats and shuts down on the phone. Please let us know when you have a solution, if this happens again I will demand a refund until you have a permanent solution.

reviews.title: iPhone 15 Charging Performance is Poor
reviews.review_text: iPhone 15 Pro Max charging performs poorly in my view. When originally purchased, I had a iPhone 11, and I assumed the weak charging performance was based the phone being older and not specifically a MagSafe device. Recently, I updated to a new phone, and the charging performance is slow. The phone can sit on the charger for an hour and perhaps the charge increases a few percent. Not sure what I fully expected, but it was certainly better than this for a premium product. Just glad it charges my AirPods and iWatch at this point. Otherwise, I would give up on the charger.

reviews.title: Well made, but not practical for travel use.
reviews.review_text: Seems well made and sturdy, but I am returning it because it is way too big and heavy to travel with-my intended use. Belkin makes great stuff, and I will definitely buy other products!

reviews.title: Does not charge Apple Watch as advertised
reviews.review_text: Product worked great for the first few months, but lately it takes over 9hrs to charge the Apple Watch. This was the main reason for buying the product. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Low rating because I wanted black….
reviews.review_text: I really wanted the black version, but Belkin screwed up and left the iPhone and watch chargers white. It looks horrible!!! And that is why I went with the white version. Come on Belkin…..do you not have any common sense in your company??! What a joke to have a blacked out charger but you use white charging points.

reviews.title: Returned- Does not work well through case
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I bought this through Apple (to make sure I got a real one). The charger for the phone did not work well with my phone case. I took off the outer portion of the phone case each night. It would still take me around 2 minutes to get the phone to sit on the charger so that it was charging. When I pulled my phone off the charger today, it was dead. so it hadn't charged. RETURN!! the apple pods and watch work well. Another con is that there is not an additional opening for a USB to charge another phone or another device like headphones or laptop.

reviews.title: No fast charging for Apple Watch except v7
reviews.review_text: Fast charging for phone, but only for Apple Watch 7?! This information is well hidden when purchasing and I only discovered when looking at the fine print on the box after receiving it. Bait and switch move.

reviews.title: Design
reviews.review_text: Great for the iPhone but horrible for the Apple Watch .watch never connects
